messages:
Maya: Quick design huddle — need a decision on the trace drilldown download/export CTA and a11y follow-ups. Do we use 'Download trace' or 'Export trace'? Also placement + keyboard behavior. Liam: Short and consistent. We already have 'Download snapshot' elsewhere so I'd keep 'Download trace'. Alex: Backend returns a ZIP and triggers a browser download. Either label maps, but 'Download' matches behavior. Sam: A11y: 'Download trace' is clearer for screen readers. Must announce progress/completion via role=status (aria-live) and ensure keyboard users get feedback. Jordan: Keyboard behavior: if immediate download, keep focus on the button and show spinner. If we show a modal for options, trap focus in the modal. Maya: Copy variants I mocked: 1) "Download trace" 2) "Export trace (ZIP)" 3) "Generate trace file". Also think primary vs secondary: primary = immediate download; secondary = export options. Liam: I vote 1 as primary and a small kebab for advanced formats. Alex: Implementation notes + snippet:
Sam: Important: don't put aria-live on the button. Use a separate status element and update text: 'Preparing download...', 'Download ready'. Make success messages dismissible or focusable. Jordan: Add a copy-to-clipboard microbutton for correlation IDs with aria-label='Copy correlation ID'. Truncate visually but expose full ID via offscreen text: abcd...1234 Full correlation id: abcd5678efgh9012ijkl Maya: Placement: keep primary CTA top-right in the drilldown toolbar, kebab immediately left for export options. Keyboard order must match visual. Liam: Also add helper tooltip: 'Includes spans, logs, attachments — ZIP ~2MB'. Ensure color contrast >= 4.5:1 on CTA. Alex: I'll implement the button, live region, tooltip, focus styles, and tests. Will ensure target size >=44px. Sam: A11y checklist I'll validate: 1) role=status live updates 2) aria-labels for all actions 3) visible focus + 44px target 4) full ID available to SRs 5) modal focus trap. I'll run axe + NVDA pass. Jordan: I'll file two tickets: trace-download live-region/focus (@alex), and correlation-id copy pattern + tests (@sam @alex). Maya: Action summary: Maya — update Figma & final copy; Alex — implement + tests (ETA Fri EOD); Sam — a11y review (ETA Mon); Jordan — tickets & QA checklist. I'll close thread after Figma + links. :thumbsup: Liam: Tiny nit: make sure focus outline color variable meets contrast. Alex: Noted — will add focus outline var and run contrast check. Maya: Thanks everyone.
